# min-grep

Regex hits inside large or minified files: file, character offset and the text around each hit.

| Param | Type | Required | Default | Help |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--path` | path | yes |  | File or folder to search |
| `--pattern` | str | yes |  | Python regular expression; prefix (?i) to ignore case |
| `--context` | int | no | `60` | Characters kept on each side of a hit |
| `--max` | int | no | `8` | Most hits to show |
| `--ext` | str | no | `.js` | File suffix to search when path is a folder |

Run it from the repo root:

```
caveman-blocks run min-grep --path <path> --pattern <str>
```

It prints one JSON object with the keys files, hits, shown, truncated.

Without the CLI, `python3 .blocks/min-grep.py --path <path> --pattern <str>` runs the same file, but nothing is enforced: no effects gate, no path confinement, no output cap.
